title: Design System: أصحاب الخيمة / Ashab Al Khaimah — Teacher dashboard

headline.purpose: Quiet literary hierarchy for teacher tasks.

heading-arabic.purpose: Amiri hierarchy with zero Latin tracking.

total.purpose: Actual published, draft and loaded submission counts; tabular isolated numerals.

shadows.name: flat-working-surfaces
shadows.purpose: Tone, rules and clay sheets establish depth without decorative shadows.

motion.name: control-feedback
motion.purpose: Existing control state feedback; no ornamental shell animation.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Static accessible path across the teacher surface.

layouts.name: teacher-navigation
layouts.description: Desktop sidebar remains persistent; at 750px Menu / Close menu reveals all eight destinations in two columns with utilities. Escape closes and restores trigger focus; selection closes.

layouts.name: homework-views
layouts.description: Visible Assigned work / Review in person / Qur’an progress persist in the section URL parameter. Assignment editor hides underlying list and guards dirty Cancel; review retains status filters and roster.

layouts.name: sunday-control
layouts.description: Today on Sunday, otherwise upcoming; full mobile date heading above shrinkable native input between 44px week arrows, including narrow RTL. Back to this Sunday appears while away.

layouts.name: student-roster
layouts.description: Search plus active/archived lists; management sheet and archived-only exact-name/count deletion preview.

components.name: Homework inline editor
components.description: Typed Qur’an/halaqa/quiz/other editor with native recipient/range/quiz fields, student-action preview and explicit progress-reset wording. Edit exposes Remove this homework; list removal, Undo and the restore-a-mistake disclosure preserve previous progress. components.description: Searchable active/archived roster with quiet row actions. Permanent deletion appears only in an archived account’s management sheet with actual counts and exact-name confirmation.

components.name: Qur’an progress student view
components.description: Homework’s third view, reached directly from Overview. Compact Sunday cutoff and searchable active roster lead to latest teacher checks separately from readiness. Static empty-state structure; no invented student record. Cutoff filters assignment week; checks remain the latest saved per assignment, not an as-of history. At 750px selected detail hides the roster; Back to students restores the roster and focuses search.

narrative.northStar: A quiet working room inside the Najdi circle
narrative.overview:
The teacher dashboard belongs to the same deep burgundy Najdi world as the public student site. A muted geometric rug, dark fabric, warm ivory reading, amber actions, Amiri Arabic headings and Lora English headings establish that relationship. A persistent task sidebar and restrained working sheets give private teaching work its own clear organization.

The dashboard is a calm operating surface for quizzes, grades, Sunday preparation, in-person review, student accounts and approved funny answers. Actual counts and task rows carry the hierarchy. Keep the Sadu seam at the navigation edge and teacher entry; content receives space, fine rules and quiet tonal separation. There is no ornamental animation in the teacher shell.
keyCharacteristics: Deep burgundy rug and dark working ground, with warm ivory reading and amber actions.
A persistent logical-start sidebar that becomes a compact sticky Menu / Close menu header on mobile.
Clay editing sheets, cream fields and visible save actions.
Equal English and Arabic functionality with mirrored layout and isolated mixed-script numbers.
Real operational counts, clear task rows and restrained Sadu detail.

rules.name: The Working Contrast Rule
rules.body: Dark task surfaces use warm light reading; clay editing sheets use dark reading and burgundy controls. Preserve the local form palette through labels, help, notes, choices and source evidence.

rules.name: The Two Scripts Rule
rules.body: Mirror the interface with its language: Amiri for Arabic headings, Lora for English headings and the appropriate sans serif for reading and actions.

rules.name: The Quiet Dashboard Rule
rules.body: Keep the private shell still and task-led; use short existing control feedback instead of lantern loops, ornamental motion or ceremonial panels. Reduced motion disables animations, transitions and smooth scrolling.

dos: Do carry the public burgundy Najdi palette and Amiri/Lora/script pairing into private work.
Do preserve the sidebar hierarchy and its RTL/mobile equivalents.
Do keep form text, choices and source evidence dark and readable on clay.
Do show actual quiz, draft, submission and homework data.
Do retain 44px targets, labels, focus, skip navigation and reduced motion.
Do preserve explicit save/publish, validation, teacher approval and private controls.
donts: Don't restore the obsolete cream public shell, Reem Kufi identity, League palette or no-sidebar contract for the teacher dashboard.
Don't add ornamental loops, student hero scenery or decorative data charts to private work.
Don't replace the native Sunday date control with a custom picker.
Don't expose private answer keys or teacher editing controls through student views.
Don't treat older screenshots or invented data as evidence of current production behavior.
